svg.aria-label: What happens when the quote form is submitted: the lead is written to a Google Sheet by sendBeacon and posted to Web3Forms by fetch, in parallel, and with scripting off the native form post still reaches the same inbox.
svg.title: What happens when the quote form is submitted
svg.desc: One submission fans out to two independent destinations. A sendBeacon call appends the lead as a row to a Google Sheet, best effort, and a fetch POST sends it to Web3Forms which emails the owner. Neither waits on the other. With scripting off the form posts natively to the same inbox.
